## Problem / Motivation

A clear description of the problem or use case this feature would address.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, share them here.
For new tools, describe what the tool would do and what parameters it would take.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
